objects.taxonomy_description: Large ferocious bear of Eurasia with a thick, shaggy coat in various shades of brown. Coat is long, dense, and coarse ranging from light blonde to dark brown with a distinctive shoulder hump of muscle. Body is massive, heavily built, and well-muscled with a prominent shoulder hump and powerful legs. Head is broad with a dished facial profile and short muzzle. Ears are small, rounded, and set wide apart. Tail is very short and hidden in fur. Eyes are small, dark, and deep-set. The breed's signature features include its massive size, shoulder hump, dished face profile, and variable brown coat color.

objects.taxonomy_description: Uncastrated adult male sheep measuring 65-110 cm at withers weighing 35-180 kg. Body covered with dense woolly fleece in white, brown, or black. Head broad with laterally spiraling horns (in horned breeds). Horns thick and ridged. Eyes dark with horizontal rectangular pupils. Ears lateral and drooping. Neck thick and muscular. Body compact and stocky. Legs sturdy with cloven hooves. Tail short. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, wool insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Secondary sexual characteristics include larger size and prominent horns.

Head_and_Face: Broad head with laterally spiraling horns (in horned breeds).
Dark eyes with horizontal rectangular pupils.
Body_and_Plumage: Body covered with dense woolly fleece in white, brown, or black.
Compact stocky body with moderate to substantial proportions at the withers.

objects.taxonomy_description: Brass wind instrument with compact conical tubing coiled into oval shape. Length approximately 33 cm. Bell flares to 11-12 cm diameter, facing forward. Three piston valves arranged vertically on top with mother-of-pearl or plastic finger buttons. Mouthpiece is cup-shaped, detachable, inserted into leadpipe. Body surface is lacquered brass (golden-yellow) or silver-plated (bright white-metal). Tubing diameter gradually increases from mouthpiece to bell. Valve casings are cylindrical with visible seam lines. Bell rim is rolled edge. Finger hooks and thumb ring present for grip.
